response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced full-stack/staff-level engineer with ~19 years of broad software experience (web, mobile, embedded, systems programming), which technically satisfies the 15-year minimum. However, the role requires recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products/platforms, strategic customer advisory skills, and thought leadership on cloud/AI strategy — none of which are evidenced here. His only AI-related exposure is a few months of MCP tooling work in his current role, and his talks/workshops focus on D language, testing, and web internals rather than AI or cloud strategy.
strengths: Extensive (~19-year) hands-on engineering background across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Strong software craftsmanship track record: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, public speaking/workshops
Demonstrated versatility across many languages/stacks and comfort operating independently (founder of GISCollective)
concerns: Virtually no demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI product/platform ownership — only a few months of MCP tooling exposure
No evidence of strategic advisory experience with customers/partners or executive-level influence, which is core to this role
No advanced degree or specialized credential in AI, and no entrepreneurial experience within a larger organization

key_factors.factor: No strategic/customer advisory or Director-level scope experience
Meets baseline years-of-experience and engineering breadth requirement
